overview.title: 1. Overview & Commitment
overview.content:
RasoHi ("RasoHi Platform") is committed to protecting your privacy, data security, and rights under applicable laws, including India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act and international privacy standards.

Whether you operate a registered home kitchen or order authentic home-cooked meals as a consumer, we respect your rights to transparency and data control.

collection.title: 2. Information We Collect
collection.content:
We collect essential information to facilitate home meal ordering, dispatch, and kitchen management:

• Account Information: Name, verified mobile phone number, email address, and profile picture.
• Kitchen & Chef Data: Kitchen name, FSSAI registration number, hygiene certifications, dish menus, lead times, and payout bank/UPI details.
• Delivery Details: Apartment/society block, flat number, gate entry instructions, and precise geo-location during delivery windows.
• Payment Data: Transaction logs, order amounts, and payment IDs processed via PCI-DSS compliant partner payment gateways (e.g. Razorpay/UPI). We NEVER store raw card numbers.

use.title: 3. How We Use Your Data
use.content:
Your data is strictly processed for legitimate platform operations:

1. Fulfilling orders, calculating batch delivery routes, and scheduling chef preparation.
2. Settling kitchen wallet payouts and processing customer refunds.
3. Facilitating masked in-app chat between consumers, chefs, and delivery partners without revealing personal phone numbers.
4. Resolving support tickets raised with our CRM team.
5. Ensuring food hygiene safety and preventing fraudulent activity.

privacy_controls.title: 4. Privacy Controls & Number Masking
privacy_controls.content:
We build privacy into every workflow:

• Number Masking: When contacting a chef or delivery partner, phone numbers remain completely hidden and routed via virtual masking or encrypted in-app chat.
• Kitchen Address Control: Chefs can choose to display their society name while keeping exact flat numbers private from public listing search.
• Identity Preferences: Chefs and consumers can toggle identity privacy settings directly in their account profile.

sharing.title: 5. Data Sharing & Third Parties
sharing.content:
We DO NOT sell your personal information. Data is shared exclusively with:

• Assigned Delivery Partners: Only necessary delivery addresses and gate notes during an active order cycle.
• Payment Service Providers: RBI-approved payment gateways for processing UPI, Netbanking, or Card payments.
• Regulatory & Legal Authorities: Only when required by law or food safety regulations (e.g. FSSAI verification).

rights.title: 6. Your Rights & Data Control
rights.content:
You maintain complete control over your personal data:

• Right to Access & Export: Request a copy of your transaction logs, kitchen listings, and profile data.
• Right to Rectification: Update or correct inaccurate information in your profile settings.
• Account Deletion & Right to Be Forgotten: You can request full account and data deletion at any time by contacting our Data Protection Officer.

contact.title: 7. Contact Data Protection Officer
contact.content:
If you have questions, privacy concerns, or data requests, please contact our Data Protection Officer:

Email: privacy@rasohi.com
Support CRM: Open a ticket under "Account & Safety" in Help & Support
Address: Anvya AI Solutions Pvt. Ltd., Artha SEZ, Tech Zone IV, Greater Noida West, Uttar Pradesh, India.

0.q: How do pre-order lead times work for home chefs?
0.a: Chefs set lead times (e.g. 2 hours or 24 hours) for batch preparation. Once an order window closes, the kitchen begins cooking for scheduled dispatch.

1.q: When do chefs receive wallet payout settlements?
1.a: Earnings are accumulated after delivery completion and settled directly to your registered UPI/bank account within 24-48 hours.

2.q: What hygiene standards and audits are required?
2.a: All kitchens follow FSSAI registration compliance, wear hairnets, use leak-proof sealed containers, and undergo periodic hygiene verification.

3.q: Can an order be cancelled after cooking starts?
3.a: Orders can be cancelled prior to kitchen acceptance. Once preparation begins, refund requests are reviewed by CRM support on a case-by-case basis.

4.q: Are phone numbers shared directly with buyers/sellers?
4.a: No. Rasohi masks phone numbers and routes all communication through encrypted in-app messaging for privacy.
